structured.approach: I followed BE-05 in the backend-steps skill. I read every contracted input in full (task.components, feat.design, feat.stories, org.engineering_stack, org.lessons). As background I read feat.clarifications (DES-03) with context_get, to check for answers on the version step and the test location. Before editing I used `codegraph explore` to read the exact source, callers and blast radius of aging_buckets, days_past_due, bucket_for and BUCKETS. I then made the smallest additive change that task.components A1 to A6 and I1 to I3 list, following feat.design B3.2 line for line. I also wrote the documentation the brief asks for (docs/ap_aging.md and README.md). Next I ran `codegraph sync` and `codegraph affected`, then the CI. Compile, the 3 existing tests and the static checks pass. Coverage is 71.4% against the 90.0 gate, because the new functions have no tests yet. Tests are outside this step's write scope (src/ap_aging/, docs/, README.md), and the workflow assigns them to BE-06, so I reported this as a failed CI rather than working around it. I did not commit. task.secrets_scope was not opened; no secret is needed.
tools_used: Bash: git status / git diff --stat / git log

claims.text: overdue_with_risk was added to src/ap_aging/aging.py with the signature (invoices: Iterable[Dict], as_of: date, risk_by_vendor: Dict[str, str]) -> List[Dict]. It skips invoices where inv.get("paid") is truthy, keeps only days_past_due > OVERDUE_AFTER_DAYS (30), builds rows with exactly id, vendor, days, amount (quantised to Decimal 0.01) and risk (default 'unknown'), and sorts by (-days, id).
overdue_with_risk never calls bucket_for, because bucket_for(30) returns "31-60" while an invoice exactly 30 days past due must not be listed.

overdue_rows_to_json(rows) -> str returns json.dumps of objects in CT-1 key order: id, vendor, days as int, amount as str(Decimal(...).quantize(TWO_PLACES)), risk. It gives '[]' for no rows and never uses float.
BUCKETS, days_past_due, bucket_for and aging_buckets are unchanged; the change is additive and keeps every existing public signature.

src/ap_aging/__init__.py exports aging_buckets, overdue_with_risk and overdue_rows_to_json in __all__. __version__ moves from 1.4.0 to 1.5.0 as the minor step the design calls for, for the lane to confirm.
CI result: compile true, 3 tests run with 0 failures and 0 errors, no static issues, and coverage 71.4 (aging.py 39 statements, 12 missed: lines 22, 47-63, 71), so passed is false.
The CI gate requires coverage of at least 90.0, and the org stack requires line coverage of at least 90% in every CI.
git diff --stat shows 3 files changed, 62 insertions, 5 deletions; docs/ is new and untracked. Nothing was committed.
codegraph affected reported no test files affected by the changed files, and the earlier explore showed tests/test_aging.py covering bucket_for, aging_buckets and days_past_due.
README.md was updated and docs/ap_aging.md created, because the brief asks for module docs. task.components had listed README as no change.
Decisions D-2026-031, D-2026-044 and D-2026-050 and lessons L-007 and L-011 are applied: calendar days via days_past_due, Decimal only, paid excluded, and a strict > on the 30-day boundary.
